title: Finite scalar extension of a realized point diagram
statement: Fix finite-field datum D, prime l different from its characteristic, finite extensions E and L of Q_l and a Q_l-algebra embedding iota:E→L. For any category I, E-module diagram V, operators A_i, a raw heart-valued diagram G, and natural Weil and fibre isomorphisms theta and eta with transport isomorphisms t satisfying ZlPointDiagramRealization of [def-zl-point-equivariant-diagram-realization], the predicate ZlFiniteScalarDiagram(D,l,hl,E,L,iota,V,A,G,theta,eta,t) holds. Thus the scalar-extended diagram lies in the L-heart, realizes the extended exact diagrams and operators, and has precisely the specified scalar/pullback and scalar/fibre component formulas and point-transport square. The input diagram is supplied; no existence or prescribed-object lifting is asserted here.

proof.text:
For a finite extension $E\subset L\subset\Omega$, let $M_{i,L}=M_i\otimes_E L$, and use the prescribed pullback comparison $\alpha_i:(T_E M_i)\otimes_E L\cong T_L M_{i,L}$. The extended Weil map is $(\theta_i\otimes1)\alpha_i^{-1}$, with inverse $\alpha_i(v_i\otimes1)$. The scalar/truncation compatibility of [prop-constructible-truncations] keeps these objects in the heart. Let $c_i:\omega_L(M_{i,L})\cong\omega_E(M_i)\otimes_E L$ be the specified comparison of [lem-zl-point-heart-finite-stage], and set $\eta_{i,L}=(\eta_i\otimes1)c_i$. Scalar compatibility in [lem-weil-frobenius-point-transport-natural](2) says precisely that, after $c_i$ and the analogous comparison for $T_E M_i$ and $\alpha_i^{-1}$, $t_{i,L}$ is $t_i\otimes1$. Hence substitution in the formula gives
$$\eta_{i,L}\omega_L(\theta_{i,L})t_{i,L}\eta_{i,L}^{-1}=A_i\otimes1,$$
and each arrow has fibre $(D(u)\otimes1)$ under $\eta_{i,L}$. Identity and tower normalizations are those of the cited comparisons. Thus this is the required scalar diagram with its specified, rather than arbitrary, fibre comparisons.
